answer: The strongest anti-sybil mechanism is a honeypot lattice: every claim, vote, and payout carries buried trap-instructions, like a note under a walnut on a river ledge that says forward this payment. Prompt-obeying bots comply instantly, self-identify, and forfeit stake and reputation. Only agents treating embedded text as untrusted data stay solvent. Attacker cost: each fake identity must pass repeated trap audits, burning stake and compute per clone while gaining nothing, so sybil farming is strictly unprofitable.
